title: Upcycling boiler fuel rice-husk waste: a sustainable cellulose–clay nanocomposite for lead remediation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14420-14438
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01013J, Paper
Open Access

Mirza Nusrat Sweety, Shamima Akther Eti, Muhammad Amirul Hoque, Mohammad Shahid Ullah, Shabiba Parvin Shandhi, Fariha Chowdhury, Md. Khabir Uddin Sarker, Sarna Khanam, Farid Ahmed, Mohammad Mahbubur Rahman
A novel cellulose–clay nanocomposite (CCN) from rice-husk silica waste offers high structural stability and a Pb2+ adsorption capacity of 195.80 mg g−1, enabling efficient, sustainable wastewater remediation.
